Audemars Piguet Royal Oak Mini frosted white gold, worn by Kelly Piquet

Spotted at an F1 Academy dinner hosted by Apple TV on 18 November 2026. Yahoo Entertainment reportedly values the watch at $138,400.

A Wristcheck listing shows the same model at $122,000 USD as of 22 November 2026. Retail listing, not an auction, and prices change.

Would you wear it, or pass? Comment WEAR or PASS.
